text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, you're free after this, right? 
Let's go get a taste of what it feels like 
at the top.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Mmm! High places really are the best.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Back when I was on a team, we used to 
shoot the breeze on high hills like this 
too. Look, there are folks just like us 
over there.

text_block_list.name: Chatting Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"...Nah, no way. That's 'L/Roars', right? 
The strongest in Tokyo. There's no way 
they'd go under."

text_block_list.name: Chatting Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Thing is, apparently their current head is 
totally useless. Thanks to that, the 
team's a mess. Word is an internal 
collapse is only a matter of time.
choice_data_list:
L/Roars is collapsing from within...? What 
do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"...No clue. For now, let's go ask them 
what's up."

text_block_list.name: L/Roars Leader
text_block_list.text:
Aren't you ashamed of yourself, spreading 
false rumors like that?!

text_block_list.name: Leader of the Giant Ks
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! No problem at all. Because from 
now on, it's going to be real!

The L/Roars hangout was thick with 
explosive tension. L/Roars stood facing 
off against another team.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: "...Who are they? Those guys."

text_block_list.name: Undercut Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
It's Team "Giant K." They broke away from 
L/Roars. Actually, that's the team I'm in.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Wait, you're the one from the other day... 
Seriously? Then what are you doing here?

text_block_list.name: Undercut Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, I just wanted to be useful to you, 
Pokke-san!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
...Well, do whatever you want. So? What's 
going on with this?

text_block_list.name: Undercut Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"L/Roars called me out. 'Cause I went 
around spreading tons of rumors that 
'L/Roars is going under soon.'"
choice_data_list: Why would you spread a rumor like that...?

text_block_list.name: Undercut Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I'm suggesting to the others that we 
'leave L/Roars and take them down.' If 
more members defect, L/Roars will start to 
waver, right?

text_block_list.name: L/Roars Leader
text_block_list.text:
"We're getting nowhere, so let's settle 
this with a contest! A race will decide 
it. If I lose, I'll follow your orders!"

text_block_list.name: Leader of the Giant Ks
text_block_list.text:
—No way. Even if I do nothing, you guys 
will collapse soon anyway. I don't need to 
take such a risky gamble.

text_block_list.name: L/Roars Leader
text_block_list.text: Wh-what...?! Damn it, that's dirty...!!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: No way in hell!!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Run away from a fight? Don't mess with 
me!"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: You call yourself a free racer?! Huuuh?!

A terrifying pressure blankets the area, 
swallowing everything whole. It is the 
wrath radiating from Jungle Pocket. Her 
eyes gleam brightly as she locks onto her 
prey.
choice_data_list: Let's ask the leader of L/Roars for help.

We'll have to let the other team get 
away...

text_block_list.text:
—Steeling my resolve, I dashed out in 
front of her. Standing right before her, I 
was even more overwhelmed by her sheer 
presence. My knees began to tremble 
uncontrollably.
choice_data_list:
Calm down! You don't need to deal with 
them!

Calm down! You don't need to deal with 
them!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Aaaargh?!
choice_data_list: If it's L/Roars, they'll be fine, right?!

If it's L/Roars, they'll be fine, won't 
they?!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Nnnrrrgghhh, AAAAAAAHHHHHHHHHHHHHH!!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: ...Get lost already.

text_block_list.name: Leader of the Giant Ks
text_block_list.text: E... Eeeeek!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Huff…… puff………… ……Sorry for…… sticking my 
nose in……

text_block_list.name: L/Roars Leader
text_block_list.text:
...No. I'll settle things with them. I'm 
sure they'll listen this time around.

I turned to look at the L/Roars leader, 
and our eyes met. She gave an immediate 
nod and stepped forward in front of Jungle 
Pocket.

text_block_list.name: L/Roars Leader
text_block_list.text:
Pokke-san, don't get your hands dirty. 
I'll handle things here!

text_block_list.name: Lip-Pierced Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Leave it to us, Pokke-san!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: NGHHHAAAAAAAAAAAAGH!!

text_block_list.name: Leader of the Giant Ks
text_block_list.text: E... Eeeeek!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Huff…… puff………… …………I'm leaving it to you.

text_block_list.name: L/Roars Leader
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. I'll make sure they learn their 
lesson so they never look down on us 
again.

Under Jungle Pocket's glare, I shout 
toward Giant K, who is completely cowering 
in fear.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Aaaargh?!

BAM! The floor where Jungle Pocket stepped 
gouged to an impossible depth. Scattering 
debris, her right leg tore into the ground 
again and again.

text_block_list.name: Leader of the Giant Ks
text_block_list.text: E... Eeeeek! I-I am so, so sooorrrryyyy!

Screaming at the top of their lungs, the 
members of Giant K scrambled and fled for 
their lives...

text_block_list.name: Undercut Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Pokke-san, leave the rest to me! I'll 
upload this getaway footage to show 
everyone the rumors about L/Roars are 
completely bogus!

It looks like the trouble that broke out 
in L/Roars is finally heading towards a 
resolution.
choice_data_list:
I'm sorry for stopping you back then. 
But...

I'm sorry for stopping you back then. 
But...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Whoa, stop right there! You actually 
stepped in front of the Roaring Demon?! 
You've got some serious guts! Ahahaha!"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Not at all. Though I was surprised.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Surrounded by all those fired-up folks, 
it's impressive you managed to step in and 
stop them.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: That gave me serious chills!!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Just what I'd expect from my partner. Now 
I can snap and let loose with total peace 
of mind.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! Well then, keep watch right by my 
side at all times. Deal?!
